entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I need to return something. My VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... let me see... VF789012.

Thank you, Sarah. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. To start the process, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken. It's just... I find it so hard to use. The whole interface is very confusing to me. I've read the user manual twice, but I just can't get it to do what I thought it would.
I see. I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations.
I really expected more, you know? It all seemed so simple on the website. I just feel overwhelmed by it. Can't you just help me? I'd really just like to send it back and get a refund.
Of course, I understand. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment... Okay, I see the order was delivered 44 days ago.
Oh, is that too long? I'm sorry, I just kept trying to make it work.
No, not at all. According to our policy here, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending an email to you now with a prepaid shipping label and an RMA number. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your full refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you again for making that so easy.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Have a great day!
You too, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
